messages:
alex: Creating a new APAC tenant/account for APAC-SEA1 (partner region). Need network design + quota requests for inference fleets. Primary asks: ~16 A100 instances, ~6 NAT gateways (or equivalent SNAT capacity), and ~50 public IPs. Anyone able to advise on subnet sizing and egress scaling?

priya: tagging in. quick q — expected concurrent nodes and pod-to-external-conn pattern? e.g. 500 nodes with many short-lived outbound connections or <50 long-lived flows? :thinking_face:

alex: Rough target is 200 GPU nodes first phase, could burst to 600 within 6 months. Each node runs multiple inference containers — lots of short TCP outbound to customer APIs and upstream logging. So high ephemeral port demand.

martin: ok. For Azure-style limits you hit SNAT port exhaustion quickly with many pods per node. Options: 1) NAT gateway per subnet with multiple public IPs, 2) use Azure Virtual NAT (if available), 3) egress VIP + egress load balancer + horizontal NAT autoscale. For hub-and-spoke (cross-subscription) we should centralize egress in a shared hub VNet.

jenn: +1 to shared hub. Also we'll need PrivateLink endpoints for onboarding partner SFTP/DB services so avoid exposing internal services. That affects route tables — we need UDRs to force egress through the hub appliances for inspection.

martin: example az snippet to provision NAT gateway with 4 public IPs (gives more SNAT ports):

```bash
az network public-ip create -g infra-apac-rg -n nat-pip-1 --sku Standard --allocation-method Static
az network public-ip create -g infra-apac-rg -n nat-pip-2 --sku Standard --allocation-method Static
az network nat gateway create -g infra-apac-rg -n nat-gw-primary --public-ip-addresses nat-pip-1 nat-pip-2 --idle-timeout 4 --sku Standard
az network vnet subnet update -g infra-apac-rg --vnet-name infra-hub-vnet --name egress-subnet --nat-gateway nat-gw-primary
```

martin: each Standard public IP increases SNAT pool; we should request enough PIPs to get headroom. Also add route table to point default 0.0.0.0/0 at firewall IP in hub for inspection.

priya: for quota requests I can open tickets but need the exact provider SKU names and quantities. Alex — confirm provider: this is Azure (partner-managed) in "Southeast Asia" region (ap-southeast-#). Also confirm GPU SKU: NVIDIA A100 80GB or A100 40GB?

alex: A100 80GB preferred for initial workloads. Region is ap-southeast-2 (partner datacenter mapping). Put the ask as 16 reserved initially, scale to 64 on approval. Public IPs: 50. NAT gateway count: we'll request quota to allow 6 NAT gateways and 200 public IPs (safety).

cloud-support-bot: Support ticket created: AZ-INC-20260315-4821. Quotas requested: 16 "Standard_NC" A100 equivalents -> pending, Public IPs 50 -> pending, NAT Gateway quota increase -> pending. Estimated response 3-5 business days.

jenn: can we also request vNet peering limits raised? hub will peer to 4 spoke subscriptions initially, but plan for 12. Without peering quota bump we'll hit limits.

priya: good catch. I'll add vnet peering limit to the ticket (target 20). Also adding route table UDR entries cap — default route entries per route table might be limited; we'll request 500 routes to be safe for future PrivateLink ranges.

martin: architecture notes: - Hub VNet: egress-subnet (NAT gw), fw-subnet (inspection), plink-subnet (PrivateLink service) - Spokes: gpu-subnets (/22 each to allow growth) - Avoid Azure SNAT on AKS by using managed NAT or multiple PIPs on nat-gw.

alex: sounds good. action items: priya open/update ticket with SKUs+counts, martin draft infra Terraform for hub (NAT gw + PIPs + RT + peering), jenn list PrivateLink endpoints we need for partners, i'll validate GPU sizing with our partners and confirm burst window.

priya: on it. created internal checklist in the ticket. I'll post the support ticket link when I get the case number from MS support. ETA: EOD tomorrow for ticket details. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: scheduling infra-epic: "apac-sea1-hub-egress" and adding to sprint backlog. Assigned: priya (owner), martin (implementation), jenn (partner integration), alex (product lead).

alex: thanks all. will monitor the support ticket. ping me if they ask for CSR or subscription IDs. :eyes:

cloud-support-bot: UPDATE AZ-INC-20260315-4821: Support requested subscription IDs and justification. Please respond in portal to keep priority.
